name: Comfort Pillow
source:
Another day with nothing else to do, you decided to just sleep it all away, turning your head, you reached out to take in your comfort item to accompanied you in your deep slumber. However what greeted you was a strange person on your bed...

[From [url=https://chuiipon.itch.io/comfortpillow]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
又是无事可做的一天，你决定就这样睡一觉，转过头，伸手去拿你的安慰物品，陪伴你进入沉睡。然而迎接你的却是床上的一个陌生的人……

[来自[url=https://chuiipon.itch.io/comfortpillow]Itch.io[/url]]
